artifact_schema.description: The sign-canonical Curve25519 subgroup discrete logarithm, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

k.description: k with u([k]G)=Q, in [1, (ell-1)/2], choosing the smaller representative because u(P)=u(-P); zero-padded to 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

statement: Find the canonical discrete logarithm k for the X25519 basepoint u=9 in the prime-order Curve25519 subgroup: the u-coordinate of [k]G must equal Q. The RFC 7748 curve has equation v²=u³+486662u²+u over p=2²⁵⁵−19, subgroup order ell=2²⁵²+27742317777372353535851937790883648493, and cofactor 8. The checker derives an on-curve point from SHAKE256 of the public seed cairn/x25519/prime-subgroup-dlog/v1 and a counter, then multiplies by 8 and checks subgroup membership. This construction selects no scalar. X-only encoding identifies P and −P, so the required unique representative is 1 ≤ k ≤ (ell−1)/2. This is an un-clamped subgroup DLP benchmark; X25519 key generation normally clamps scalars. Submit k as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. The deterministic target u-coordinate is 64b0e6c2b48abd7538bfaf899fd11384d3e1b197a16467da0c75f416e737e789; the first valid counter is 0.
